title: Revived-pool permissionless-stake window before migrateIn (exploit refuted; emission-dilution only)
description: After finalizeAndReset the empty pool is Active and stake is permissionless before migrateIn runs; an interloper can stake first. Theft/inflation/rate-manipulation vectors REFUTED: reward accounting is a MasterChef accumulator (accPhusdPerShare/rewardDebt), not a totalAssets-derived share price, so there is no first-depositor inflation, parked principal is unreachable by outsiders, and migrateIn credits each user their own pinned amt. Sole residual: emission-share dilution (standard MasterChef TVL dilution of in-motion/unmatured yield), which is the normal intended consequence of more TVL, not a leak.
impact: None to principal; emission-share dilution only. Law-3 operational footgun (revival session not pause-wrapped). Kept in a visible channel per Law 1 (refuted-exploit disposition documented, not dropped). Same revival-runbook surface as ss9l1 (stale-config) and ss10l1 (dust-stake gate-grief); distinct root cause.
recommendation: Pause-wrap the out->reset->rewire->in revival session (stake is whenNotPaused; finalizeAndReset/setYieldStrategy/migrateIn are pause-tolerant) so no interloper can stake into the transiently-empty revived pool. Consider bundling with ss9l1/ss10l1 under one 'revival-window pause-wrap' QA recommendation.
